question: The average age of 40 students of a class is 18 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 19 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of new member = Old Average + (Total members × Increase in average)

⇒ Age of teacher = 18 + (41 × 1)

⇒ Age of teacher = 18 + 41 = 59

**∴ The correct answer is 59 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 40

Average age of 40 students = 18 years

New average age after including the teacher = 19 years

**Formula Used:**

Total sum of ages = Average × Number of people

 
 40 Students (Sum = 40 × 18) Avg = 18 41 Persons (Sum = 41 × 19) Avg = 19 
• + 1 Teacher 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 40 students = 40 × 18 = 720 years

⇒ Total number of people (including teacher) = 40 + 1 = 41

⇒ Total age of 41 persons = 41 × 19 = 779 years

⇒ Age of the teacher = (Total age of 41 persons) − (Total age of 40 students)

⇒ Age of the teacher = 779 − 720

⇒ Age of the teacher = 59 years

**∴ The correct answer is 59 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Change Method for Averages

When a new member joins and the average increases: New Value = Old Average + (Total New Members × Increase in Average).

Leaving the Group

If a person leaves the group and the average decreases, the departing person's value is greater than the average: Value = Old Average + (Remaining Members × Decrease in Average).

Replacement in Averages

When one person replaces another: Difference in values = Total Members × Change in Average. If the overall average increases, the new person has a greater value than the replaced person.
